review.scope: Source-only follow-up review at the supplied commit of the four HANDOVER_RECOVERY_REVIEW_20260906 blockers and their fixes, nightly scheduling wiring, and the proposed inactive systemd unit boundaries (handover_coordinator, handover_runtime, protected_handover, actions_admission, git_publication, supplied tests, deploy units, operator docs). Reviewed for correctness, privacy, authority boundaries, persistent artifacts, fail-closed behavior, identity bindings, recovery semantics, and preservation of scientific approvals. No tests executed; no installation, live writer grant, protected Actions API collection, or pre-launch repair handler certified as deployed.
findings: FIXED (blocker 1, verified in source): Runtime.model derives the stage from binding['stages'][position]; Runtime.validate_binding pins canonical ['continuation','review','disposition'], enforced at Coordinator.submit and re-checked each tick; the broker independently pins model family ('claude' only for the review stage), preserving fixed-role review identity. Covered by test_noncanonical_stages_refuse_before_admission.

FIXED (blocker 2, verified in source): bookkeeping is per-task isolated with an attempts cap (BLOCKED after 3), LIMIT 32 per tick, terminal entries never rescanned, and the failure path releases a stuck REVIEWING claim via Queue.unavailable so a claimed review never pretends to run. Covered by test_bookkeeping_failure_does_not_block_other_completed_task.

FIXED (blocker 3, status level): stage_status returns distinct NOT_STARTED_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED when started.json is absent, and Coordinator.recover propagates it without retry. The bounded pre-launch repair handler remains explicitly unfinished; HANDOVER_SERVICE_DRAFT.md documents the operator reconciliation route and that the affected task stays blocked while other eligible work continues — acknowledged next-phase gap, not certified deployed. Minor: broker NOT_OBSERVED_NO_RETRY maps to the uncertain reason rather than not-started (conservative, informational only).

FIXED (blocker 4, verified in source): Runtime.controls wraps the receipt write; a failed write records WRITE_BLOCKED in the outcome and the SQLite control_delivery table, and processing continues to the next request instead of aborting the tick. Covered by test_control_receipt_failure_is_recorded_and_next_request_applies.

SCHEDULING (verified in source, previously an acknowledged gap): scheduled_report reads a root-owned installed evidence file bound to the pinned source, deduplicates per local day atomically (BEGIN IMMEDIATE) in Coordinator.schedule, submits the canonical nightly binding, and cannot be recursively triggered by review/disposition output; idle polling spends no model calls. Minor: a controller outage from the scheduled local time through local midnight silently skips that day's report (honest NOT_REVIEWED handling applies).

SYSTEMD BOUNDARIES (proposed, inactive — reviewed as source only): broker root confined to the fixed runuser launcher with ProtectSystem=strict, UMask=0077 and pinned ReadWritePaths; systemd-owned socket root:research-runtime 0660 plus SO_PEERCRED controller-uid check; controller non-root with PrivateNetwork, no sudo; timer documented as enable-only-after-activation-gates. Not certified installed or active.

PRESERVED: the publication .socket suffix addition retains all content checks — same secret/case-identifier/NUL/UTF-8 scans apply with no new exemption; test_metadata_and_case_payload_scans exercises '.socket'. Pinned publication destination/repository, contaminated-history rejection, exact-hash historical exemptions, and operator-only reset/initialize (unreachable via socket) all remain intact.

SUGGESTION (tamper-path liveness, not a blocker): a hash-mismatched or symlinked stage receipt on a RUNNING task raises out of Coordinator.tick before any per-task blocking — Runtime.recover's exception path sets a reason but leaves status RUNNING — stalling all tasks every tick until operator repair. Fail-closed and reachable only via private-state corruption, but it conflicts with block-only-the-affected-task; smallest fix is to set BLOCKED in Runtime.recover's except path or catch receipt-verification errors per task in tick.

RETAINED MINORS (unchanged from prior review, acceptable pre-installation): supervised model-turn budget counts refused turn folders with no reclamation route; pause takes effect at the next task's admission gate; non-activated socket has a brief pre-chmod window (mitigated by service UMask); controls() silently skips non-64-hex request filenames.

NEXT-PHASE (explicitly unfinished, not certified, distinct from blockers): actual installation and activation evidence, live writer grant and shared-state initialization, protected Actions API collection feeding actions_admission.verify/Broker.actions_admission, and the reviewed bounded pre-launch repair handler. No approval here extends to deployed behavior; this review ran no tests and claims none.
